name: smwmusic-kirby-super-star-trees-in-the-depths-of-the-earth
title: Kirby Super Star - Trees in the Depths of the Earth
description:
The adventurous and memorable jungle theme from 'The Great Cave Offensive' in Kirby Super Star, now in unsampled form! I personally love this song very much.

Update: Now vastly improved with many quality of life changes, such as the medium strings using @6 instead or @1, and better percussion. However, there's a minor insert size increase from 0xDB9 to 0xDC4 bytes.

Update 2: Improved orchestra hit and wood block.

Update 3: Changed noise crashes' volume from v230 to v180 and the attack of the wood block from F to E.
